name: cloud-native-ebpf-networking
description: Use when the user asks about XDP, tc/tcx eBPF hooks, the Cilium datapath, kube-proxy replacement, DSR, netkit, BPF maps for networking, or dropping DDoS traffic with XDP. Explains kernel packet hooks and writes verifier-safe libbpf CO-RE XDP programs. Not for operating Cilium (use cilium-ebpf) or eBPF tracing (use cloud-native-ebpf-observability).
